## Review checklist

- [ ] Branch CI passed before opening this PR; PR CI also passes on the current merge candidate.
- [ ] No private source material, credentials, transcripts or local paths included.
- [ ] Tests cover the actual behavior, including a failing/negative example where relevant.
- [ ] For layout changes: downloaded and inspected ALL affected slide previews; arrows and text verified.
- [ ] Visual limits / font substitutions / unsupported cases are documented (or not applicable).
- [ ] Changes to skill source bump its version; source/output relationships are traceable.
- [ ] No protection bypass or direct main update is needed.
